goal: Daily AI moderation reports, .edu email verification at sign-up, admin-only Reports dashboard with emailed sign-in codes
summary: Sign-up now needs a verified .edu email: RegisterPanel asks for name + school email, POST /api/auth/email/start emails a 6-digit code (lib/email-codes.ts, HMAC-hashed in email_codes, 10 min, 5 tries), /api/auth/email/verify returns a signed token (lib/verified-email.ts) that POST /api/users requires; the address is stored in users.email, never returned. Daily cron /api/cron/moderate (04:00 UTC, before expire-groups) runs lib/moderation.ts: gathers usernames, group names, the last 24h of chat and recently updated notes into one document (archived to moderation/<date>.json), sends it in 12k-char chunks to OCI GenAI with an Orbit-specific moderator preamble, and stores flags in moderation_reports (deduped by a hash of the flagged text). Keyword fallback when GenAI is unset. /admin: email-code sign-in for ADMIN_EMAILS (default eluo.5230@gmail.com), HttpOnly signed 8h cookie, then a 'Reports' list (Category | Summary rows that expand to severity, reason, flagged text, author, room, times and a /g/<room> link). Mail goes over SMTP (nodemailer); with SMTP unset codes print to the server log.

decisions.what: Codes stored hashed in the DB (email_codes) rather than stateless signed challenges
decisions.why: Attempt counting has to survive across serverless instances; the in-process rate limiter alone can't stop brute force of a 6-digit code.
Usernames and group names are re-reviewed every night; the same text should be reported once, but a renamed user is reviewed again.

decisions.what: Moderation runs in its own cron at 04:00 UTC, not inside expire-groups
decisions.why: expire-groups (09:00 UTC) deletes emptied rooms with their chat and notes; review has to see them first. 04:00 UTC is ~11 PM Nashville, i.e. end of day.

decisions.what: Username reports link to the user's current room; no new profile URL
decisions.why: User asked not to create new link types; /g/<name> is the only item page.

decisions.what: Email is not unique and there is no email login
decisions.why: Out of scope; unique emails without email login would lock out anyone who loses their browser profile.

decisions.what: addReports uses MERGE per row instead of INSERT with batchErrors
decisions.why: In thin mode a duplicate key within one executeMany batch threw ORA-00001 for the whole batch instead of being collected.

verification.manual: Local dev on the memory store with real OCI GenAI: non-.edu rejected, wrong/reused code and tampered token rejected, full sign-up through the UI; moderation cron reviewed 99 items and flagged 6 planted ones (gift-card scam, selling answers, doxxing, prompt injection, cheating group name, scam username) and skipped benign 'this exam is going to kill me lol'; a rerun added 0. /admin: unauth and forged cookie 401, non-admin email gets no code, sign-in with code shows Reports, rows expand with the room link; checked at 375px. Shared DB migrated with db:migrate --upgrade (users.email, email_codes, moderation_reports); Oracle smoke test of saveEmailCode/checkEmailCode/addReports (incl. duplicates)/listReports passed, test rows deleted.

next_steps: Set on Vercel: AUTH_SECRET, SMTP_HOST/SMTP_PORT/SMTP_USER/SMTP_PASSWORD, EMAIL_FROM (OCI Email Delivery needs an approved sender), optionally ADMIN_EMAILS.
After deploy, trigger /api/cron/moderate once with the cron secret and check /admin.
open_questions: Should a verified .edu email also let people log back in on a new device (email login)?
conflict_notes: components/auth/AuthWindow.tsx RegisterPanel was rewritten (email + code step); AuthGate passes a VerifiedEmail to Welcome. Store interface gained saveEmailCode/checkEmailCode/addReports/listReports and createUser takes an email argument.
